questions.question: How many approvals does a pull request need?

a.question: How many approvals does a pull request need?
a.answer:
SOURCE 1
Title: Engineering Standards
Section: Code Review
Status: current, version 3, effective 2026-01-15
Text: - Every pull request needs 2 approvals before merge.
- Authors cannot approve their own pull request. At least one approver must be a developer who has not worked on the change.
- The automated build and tests must pass before a merge is possible.
- Reviewers aim to respond within one working day. Large changes should be split into pull requests that can be reviewed in under an hour.

SOURCE 2
Title: Software Tool Purchase Approval
Section: Steps
Status: current, version 2, effective 2026-02-15
Text: 1. Describe the need and the expected benefit in a short request to the Operations Manager.
2. Check the subscription list: if an existing tool already does the job, use it or explain why a second tool is needed.
3. Where possible, run a free trial with the people who will use the tool.
4. Get the owner's approval.
5. Register the tool in the subscription list with plan, number of seats, monthly cost, billing day and the person responsible.
6. Only then buy the tool, using the company payment method. Do not use a personal card.

SOURCE 3
Title: Expenses, Equipment and Training Budget
Section: Expenses
Status: current, version 2, effective 2026-01-01
Text: - Expenses above 100 EUR need owner approval before you spend the money.
- Expenses of 100 EUR or less can be approved by your manager.
- Submit receipts within 30 days of the purchase. Expenses without a receipt are not reimbursed.
- Approved expenses are reimbursed with the next payroll run.

SOURCE 4
Title: Software Tool Purchase Approval
Section: Rule
Status: current, version 2, effective 2026-02-15
Text: A new software tool needs owner approval and must be registered in the subscription list before purchase.

SOURCE 5
Title: Software Tool Purchase Approval
Section: Regular Review
Status: current, version 2, effective 2026-02-15
Text: - The Operations Manager reviews the subscription list every quarter.
- Tools with no active users for 3 months in a row are cancelled unless the owner decides otherwise.
- Price increases, duplicate charges and charges from tools that are not on the list are investigated.

questions.question: Can we deploy to production on a Friday afternoon?

a.question: Can we deploy to production on a Friday afternoon?
a.answer:
SOURCE 1
Title: Release and Deployment Rules
Section: Deployment Windows
Status: current, version 2, effective 2026-02-01
Text: - Production deployments are allowed on Monday to Thursday during working hours.
- On Fridays, deployments are allowed only before 14:00. No production deployments on Fridays after 14:00.
- Deployments are also avoided on the working day before a public holiday, after 14:00.
- The person who deploys stays available for at least two hours afterwards. [Release and Deployment Rules, Deployment Windows]
